subject_line: Sepedi idioms and the poems of Moswarataukamariri
email_body:
Dear David,

I came across Moswarataukamariri, your Sepedi collection with Timbila, and also the note that your English poems in The Hoof-Printed Rock grew out of Sepedi idioms and proverbs. That movement between the two languages is what I'd most like to ask about: when an idiom carries a poem, how do you decide which language it finally lives in?

The Author Ledger is an independent project featuring short Author Spotlights. Each portrait is developed through a few written questions, which you can answer at your own pace, and the full text is shared with you for review before publication.

Would you be open to taking part? No pressure either way.

Best regards,
The Author Ledger
